Title: Create a payment
Steps: Pay 50 EUR from account ACC1001 with reference INV1
Expected Result: The payment is created with status PENDING

Title: Payment refused below the minimum balance
Pay screen rejects an amount above the limit
Steps: Open the Pay screen, enter 20000 and press Pay
Expected Result: The amount field shows an error

Title: Payment history
Expected Result: Every payment is listed with its status

Title: Account balance
Expected Result: The balance and currency are shown

Title: Accounts screen shows the balance
Expected Result: The balance of the chosen account is shown

Title: Refund a payment
Expected Result: The payment is REFUNDED; the fee is kept

Title: Exchange rates
Expected Result: EUR USD and GBP are listed

Title: Statement leaves out disputed payments
Steps: Dispute a payment then download the statement
Expected Result: The disputed payment is not in the PDF

Title: Mobile activity shows every payment
Steps: Open the activity of ACC1001 in the app
Expected Result: Every payment is listed newest first

Title: Sign in
Steps: Enter user name and password and press Sign in
